column1: # Executables and tests that are DECLARED in a dune file but wired to no alias
# or rule — with the reason, one per line (backlog-69).
# WHY THIS FILE EXISTS. scripts/check-test-alias-coverage.sh guards against the
# "vacuous test" shape: an (executable) with no run rule builds green and never
# executes. It only looked at sarek/tests/e2e/dune, one hardcoded path. Widened
# to the whole tree it finds 45 unwired targets out of 275 — and 40 of those are
# legitimately not runnable by `dune test`. A gate that reports 45 red on 39
# non-problems gets switched off, so the widening is only shippable together
# with a declaration: each unwired target states WHY, and anything unwired
# THE CHECK RUNS IN BOTH DIRECTIONS, and the second is what stops this file
# rotting. An unwired target with no line here is red. A line here for a target
# that is now WIRED, or that no longer exists, is ALSO red — otherwise a stale
# exemption would silently keep covering something that had been fixed or
# deleted, which is the same "declared but unverified" shape the declaration is
# ADDING A LINE IS A DECISION, not a way to silence the gate. If the target is a
# TEST that could run, wire it instead — that is what happened to the five this

Regression check for issue #427 (specs/transfer-pitfalls.md C-9: kernel results lost across host idle gaps on the Ryzen 7950X iGPU, fixed by uncached allocation on integrated HIP devices). Needs a ROCm device and must not run concurrently with other GPU tests on the iGPU (heavy iGPU load hard-reset the machine on 2026-10-11), so it belongs to no alias. Run by hand: make stress-427.
RSS measurement over a 3-4 GiB host array on a CPU OpenCL device; too large and device-dependent for CI. Run by hand (docs/measurements/opencl-host-ptr-2026-10-11/).
Minor-GC timing after an idle wait (R-66); load-dependent timing, compared before/after by hand, not a pass/fail check.
Host timing of one uncached epilogue coverage check on prefill shapes (specs/epilogue-fusion.md); prints microseconds, asserts nothing. Run by hand.
GPU timing of a decode-like launch chain, launch window off vs on (specs/launch-window.md CHECK-4); run by `make bench-launch-window`. Device-dependent timing does not belong on CPU-only CI.

GPU timing of an int32 GEMM, original vs launch-time matrix rewrite (specs/matrix-pattern-rewrite.md); prints milliseconds, asserts bit-identity only. Run by hand: device-dependent timing does not belong on CPU-only CI.
Hand-run timing loop (epilogue fusion off against on, alternating); wiring it to runtest would put device-dependent timing on CPU-only CI.

Host launch-overhead timing loop for kernel-argument marshalling (3 and 10 arguments); needs a CUDA driver (ZLUDA on non-NVIDIA) and is hand-run interleaved against the previous marshalling, so it belongs to no alias.
Cold-process kernel build latency with and without the OpenCL disk cache; device-dependent timing, run by hand under sarek-opencl/bench/run_ab.sh.
Host timing loop of 10000 launches on a Vulkan device, run by hand (dune exec). Wiring it to runtest would put device-dependent timing on CPU-only CI.

Host<->device bandwidth by copy path (mapped memcpy, staged, pinned import) on a Vulkan device, run by hand (dune exec). Information only; wiring it to runtest would put device-dependent timing on CPU-only CI.

GPU timing of the 8-lane float32 reduction, three shuffles against shared memory with two barriers (warp shuffle plan AC-9); alternating pairs, median, load recorded; run by hand. Device-dependent timing does not belong on CPU-only CI.
GPU timing of Sarek_gemm.Coopmat.run at an aligned size on one framework (median and best, TFLOP/s), to compare two builds; run by hand. Device-dependent timing does not belong on CPU-only CI.
